sourceCorrection: Official booklet 6379206, Base step 176 on page 106 and its installed assembly on page107 show two opposed Orange pin pairs joined by Red 2L axles through the LightBluishGray 9L beam. The earlier two pins from Base step 175 remain through the Yellow 9L beam. The original source put the opposed pair ends and axles on the Yellow plane (world y=-42) while omitting the Gray beam ends. Correct world y=-82 is the gray beam center from existing instance 0578. The corrected shaft axis, x coordinate, z coordinate and rotation are unchanged.

Page 107 independently shows this upper pin row above the existing Yellow beam pins. No geometry is added to Base step 175.

Official booklet 6379206, page 195, Turbo step 12 (global 317) places element 6343853, catalog 87552pr0012, at the end of the rear quarter window beside the White upright bricks. Official LDraw 87552p02 explicitly identifies that catalog print: https://library.ldraw.org/library/official/parts/87552p02.dat . This source left-side strip uses an unrotated panel at local x=-40; the adjacent White uprights are at x=-70, so the native -X printed corner faces the correct end. The source plain panel is replaced at its unchanged transform.

Official LDraw 87552p01 explicitly identifies that catalog print: https://library.ldraw.org/library/official/parts/87552p01.dat . This source right-side strip rotates the panel 180 degrees; its native +X printed corner therefore faces the White uprights at source-local x=-70. The source plain panel is replaced at its unchanged transform.
